method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, characteristic-function and bounded-quantifier formula comparison, reverse paraphrase and structural QA. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Primitive recursive relations via characteristic functions, Boolean closure, bounded quantification, congruence modulo n, conditional functions and definitions by ordered cases.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A relation is primitive recursive when its 0/1 characteristic function is primitive recursive. IsZero has values 1 at zero and 0 at successors. Composition yields equality through zero-testing distance and less-than-or-equal through zero-testing truncated subtraction.
samples.checks: The characteristic convention 1=true and 0=false is preserved. OLCMP-004 corrects only the frozen strict prose label; x≤y and IsZero(x dot-minus y) remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Primitive recursive relations are closed under negation, conjunction, disjunction and implication. Their characteristic functions use 1 dot-minus P, product or minimum, maximum, and maximum of not-P with Q, respectively.
samples.checks: Each connective is paired with the correct 0/1 arithmetic operation and operand order.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Bounded universal and existential quantification preserve primitive recursiveness. The empty universal bound is true and empty existential bound false. Universal quantification uses iterated minimum; existential uses maximum or negated bounded universal quantification. A ≤y bound becomes a <y+1 bound.
samples.checks: Strict z<y bounds, empty-bound conventions, min recurrence, De Morgan equivalence and the y+1 conversion are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A problem asks for primitive recursiveness of congruence modulo n. The conditional function returns y if x=0 and z otherwise, with the matching zero/successor recurrence.
samples.checks: The relation has three places and the conditional branch direction remains zero→y, successor→z.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Ordered primitive-recursive cases choose g_0 under R_0, then g_1 under R_1 and not R_0, and so on, ending with g_m otherwise. For one test this is cond(Char(not R_0),g_0,g_1); more cases compose such definitions.
samples.checks: First-match priority, the negated earlier conditions and the deliberate negated characteristic input to cond are preserved.

source_observations: MR-P137 directly attests जातिबोधक फल; OpenLogic fixes the 1/0 convention for relations.
MR-P144 directly supports Boolean and closure vocabulary; the displayed characteristic equations control the four operations.
MR-P143 directly attests a समशेषी b भाजक n for congruence modulo n.
No exact official headword was found for bounded quantification, conditional function or definition by cases; T309 and T310 therefore remain formula-controlled and expert-reviewable.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
OLCMP-004 is a same-agent deterministic source-label correction recorded in the durable issue ledger.
